name: Kusanagi
source:
Kusanagi is a former "Emanon" agent who became [url=/c10849]Aoi[/url]'s ally. 
She is [url=/c10853]Murakumo[/url]'s younger twin sister. Both of them were test subjects in a genetic research when they were "Emanon" agents. Murakumo and Kusanagi had gained the ability to transform into coyotes with red mane as a result of these tests. Kusanagi is especially skilled with long knives, and is good at close combat.
She has sexual feelings towards Murakumo.

[Translated from [url=http://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noel]the Russian Wikipedia[/url].]
